scope: Nine latest HEAD homepages and the pinned reference path at each HEAD. Owner content is not organizer confirmation.

irregularities.finding: Homepage says VENT is quarantined because historical C2ST/novelty fallback values were fabricated. This is a source self-disclosure, not an independently replayed finding here; do not reuse those claims.

Homepage describes GEMSDOE28 rung30 and GEMSDOE31 solo references as exact-mask duplicates. That does not describe the pinned artifacts used here: 37,660 and 40,199 positive cells, respectively, with unequal support. Path/variant differences would need reconciliation before adopting the owner wording.

Homepage instructs spending a slot and guarantees the range error cannot trigger. This session has neither replayed the newer KPL-36 evidence nor obtained organizer acceptance; owner wording is not a selector decision or acceptance guarantee.
